G5602.b:
⟪ὧδε⟫, adv.,
[in LXX for ⁨הֲֲלֹם ,פֹּה ,הִנֶּה⁩, etc. ;]
⟪1.⟫ prop., of manner, ⟪so⟫ (Hom., al.).
⟪2.⟫ In poets (rarely) and late writers, of place,
	⟪(a)⟫ ⟪hither⟫ (Bl, §25, 2): ⟦Matthew 8:29|Mt 8:29⟧, ⟦Mark 11:3|Mk 11:3⟧, ⟦Luke 9:41|Lk 9:41⟧, ⟦John 6:25|Jo 6:25⟧, al.; ἕως ὧδε, ⟦Luke 23:5|Lk 23:5⟧;
	⟪(b)⟫ ⟪here⟫: ⟦Matthew 12:6|Mt 12:6⟧, ⟦Mark 9:1|Mk 9:1⟧, ⟦Luke 9:33|Lk 9:33⟧, ⟦John 6:9|Jo 6:9⟧, al.; τὰ ὧδε, ⟦Colossians 4:9|Col 4:9⟧; opp. to ἐκεῖ, ⟦Hebrews 7:8|He 7:8⟧; ὧδε . . . ἢ ὧδε (ἐκεῖ), ⟦Matthew 24:23|Mt 24:23⟧, ⟦Mark 13:21|Mk 13:21⟧; metaph., ⟪here⟫ (i.e. in this circumstance or connection), ⟦1 Corinthians 4:2|I Co 4:2⟧, ⟦Revelation 13:10|Re 13:10⟧, ⟦Revelation 13:18|18⟧ ⟦Revelation 14:12|14:12⟧ ⟦Revelation 17:9|17:9⟧.

G5603.b:
⟪ᾠδή⟫, -ῆς, ή
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨שִׁיר⁩ ;] ⟪a song, ode⟫, whether sad or joyful; in LXX and NT always in praise of God or Christ: ⟦Revelation 5:9|Re 5:9⟧ ⟦Revelation 14:3|14:3⟧ ⟦Revelation 15:3|15:3⟧; ᾠ πνευματικαί ⟦Ephesians 5:19|Eph 5:19⟧, ⟦Colossians 3:16|Col 3:16⟧.†

G5604.b:
⟪ὠδίν⟫
(late form of ὠδίς), -ῖνος, ἡ [in LXX for⁨חֶבֶל⁩ (and wrongly for⁨חֶבֶל⁩, cf. Ac, l.c.), ⁨חִיל⁩, etc. ;] ⟪a birth pang, travail pain⟫: ⟦1 Thessalonians 5:3|I Th 5:3⟧; metaph., of extreme suffering, ⟦Matthew 24:8|Mt 24:8⟧, ⟦Mark 13:8|Mk 13:8⟧; ὠδῖνες θανάτου (⟦Psalms 18:4|Ps 17 (18):4⟧ ⁨הֶבְלֵי⁩⁨מָוֶת⁩), ⟦Acts 2:24|Ac 2:24⟧.†

G5605.b:
⟪ὠδίνω⟫
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨חוּל⁩, also for ⁨חבל⁩ pi., etc. ;] ⟪to have birthpangs, to travail⟫: ⟦Galatians 4:27|Ga 4:27⟧ (LXX), ⟦Revelation 12:2|Re 12:2⟧; metaph., ⟦Galatians 4:19|Ga 4:19⟧ (cf. συν-ωδίνω).†

G5606.b:
⟪ὦμος⟫, οὐ, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨שְׁכֶם⁩, ⁨כָּתֵף⁩ ;] ⟪the shoulder⟫: ⟦Matthew 23:4|Mt 23:4⟧, ⟦Luke 15:5|Lk 15:5⟧.†

G5608.b: * ⟪ὠνέομαι⟫, -οῦμαι ⟪to buy⟫: ὠνήσατο (= cl. ἐπρίατο; v. Rutherford, NPhr., 210 ff.; Veitch, s.v.), c. gen. pret., ⟦Acts 7:16|Ac 7:16⟧.†

Greek Verbs, Irregular and Defective, by W. Veitch, Oxford, 1887

G5610.b:
⟪ὥρα⟫, -ας, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨עֵת⁩ and in Da for ⁨שָׁעָה⁩ ;]
⟪1.⟫ any ⟪time⟫ or ⟪period⟫ fixed by nature, esp. a ⟪season⟫ (Hom., Hdt., Plat., al.).
⟪2.⟫ A part of the day, and esp. a twelfth part of day or night, ⟪an hour⟫: ⟦Matthew 24:36|Mt 24:36⟧, ⟦Mark 13:32|Mk 13:32⟧, ⟦Acts 10:3|Ac 10:3⟧, al.; accus. in ans. to "when"? (M, Pr., 63, 215; Bl., § 34, 8), ⟦John 4:52|Jo 4:52⟧, ⟦Acts 10:3|Ac 10:3⟧, ⟦Acts 10:30|30⟧ ⟦1 Corinthians 15:30|I Co 15:30⟧, ⟦Revelation 3:3|Re 3:3⟧; acc. of duration, ⟦Matthew 20:12|Mt 20:12⟧ ⟦Matthew 26:40|26:40⟧, ⟦Mark 14:37|Mk 14:37⟧; inexactly, πρὸς ὥραν, ⟪for a season, for a time⟫, ⟦John 5:35|Jo 5:35⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 7:8|II Co 7:8⟧, ⟦Galatians 2:5|Ga 2:5⟧; πρὸς καιρὸν ὥρας, ⟪for a short season⟫ (ICC, in l.), ⟦1 Thessalonians 2:17|I Th 2:17⟧.
⟪3.⟫ A definite point of time, ⟪time, hour⟫: ⟦Matthew 26:45|Mt 26:45⟧; c. gen. rei, ⟦Luke 1:10|Lk 1:10⟧ ⟦Luke 14:17|14:17⟧, ⟦Revelation 3:10|Re 3:10⟧, al.; c. gen. pers., ⟦Luke 22:53|Lk 22:53⟧, ⟦John 2:4|Jo 2:4⟧ ⟦John 7:30|7:30⟧, al.; ἡ ἄρτι ὥρα, ⟦1 Corinthians 4:11|I Co 4:11⟧; ἐσχάτη ὥ., ⟦1 John 2:18|I Jo 2:18⟧; seq. ὅτε, ⟦John 4:21|Jo 4:21⟧, ⟦John 4:23|23⟧ ⟦John 5:25|5:25⟧ ⟦John 16:25|16:25⟧; ἵνα, ⟦John 12:23|Jo 12:23⟧, al.; c. acc. et inf., ⟦Romans 13:11|Ro 13:11⟧ (cf. DB, ext., 475b, 476b).
a: Dictionary of the Bible, edited by J. Hastings. 5 vols. (i-iv, ext. = extra vol.). Scribners, 1898-1904
A Grammar of N.T. Greek. Vol. I, Prolegomena, by J. H. Moulton. Third Edition. Scribners, 1908

G5611.b:
⟪ὡραῖος⟫, -α, -ον
(< ὥρα), [in LXX for ⁨נָאָה⁩, ⁨טוֹב⁩, ⁨יָפֶה⁩, etc. ;] ⟪seasonable, timely⟫, esp. of ripe fruits; hence, ⟪blooming, beautiful⟫ (both of things and persons): ⟦Matthew 23:27|Mt 23:27⟧, ⟦Acts 3:2|Ac 3:2⟧, ⟦Acts 3:10|10⟧, ⟦Romans 10:15|Ro 10:15⟧ (LXX, ὥρα).†

G5612.b:
⟪ὠρύομαι⟫ depon.,
[in LXX for ⁨שׁאג⁩ ;] of animals (also of men, Hdt., al.), ⟪to roar, howl⟫: λέων, ⟦1 Peter 5:8|I Pe 5:8⟧.†

G5615.b: ⟪ὡσαύτως⟫ adv., strengthened for ὡς (in Hom, at the beginning of a clause, in the form ὣς δ' αὔτως, later in one word), in like manner, just so, likewise: ⟦Matthew 20:5|Mt 20:5⟧ ⟦Matthew 21:30|21:30⟧, ⟦Matthew 21:36|36⟧ ⟦Matthew 25:17|25:17⟧, ⟦Mark 14:31|Mk 14:31⟧, ⟦Luke 13:5|Lk 13:5⟧ ⟦Luke 20:31|20:31⟧, ⟦Romans 8:26|Ro 8:26⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 5:25|I Ti 5:25⟧, ⟦Titus 2:6|Tit 2:6⟧; with verb to be supplied from context, ⟦Mark 12:21|Mk 12:21⟧, ⟦Luke 22:20|Lk 22:20⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 11:25|I Co 11:25⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 2:9|I Ti 2:9⟧ ⟦1 Timothy 3:8|3:8⟧ ⟦1 Timothy 3:11|3:11⟧, ⟦Titus 2:3|Tit 2:3⟧.†

G5619.b: * ⟪ὡσ-περ-εί⟫ adv., as, as it were: ⟦1 Corinthians 15:8|I Co 15:8⟧.†

G5620.b:
⟪ὥσ-τε⟫ consecutive particle,
⟪1.⟫ c. infin., expressing result, so as to: ⟦Matthew 8:24|Mt 8:24⟧ ⟦Matthew 12:22|12:22⟧, ⟦Mark 1:27|Mk 1:27⟧, ⟦Luke 5:7|Lk 5:7⟧, ⟦Acts 1:19|Ac 1:19⟧, ⟦Romans 7:6|Ro 7:6⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 1:7|I Co 1:7⟧, ⟦Hebrews 13:6|He 13:6⟧, al.; of a designed result, ⟦Matthew 10:1|Mt 10:1⟧, ⟦Luke 4:29|Lk 4:29⟧, al.; preceded by οὕτως, ⟦Acts 14:1|Ac 14:1⟧; by τοσοῦτος, ⟦Matthew 15:33|Mt 15:33⟧.
⟪2.⟫ C. indic.,
⟪(a)⟫ so that: ⟦Galatians 2:13|Ga 2:13⟧, preceded by οὕτως, ⟦John 3:16|Jo 3:16⟧;
⟪(b)⟫ so then, therefore: ⟦Matthew 12:12|Mt 12:12⟧, ⟦Mark 2:28|Mk 2:28⟧, ⟦Romans 7:4|Ro 7:4⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 3:7|I Co 3:7⟧, ⟦Galatians 3:9|Ga 3:9⟧, al.
⟪3.⟫ so then, therefore: c. subjc., ⟦1 Corinthians 5:8|I Co 5:8⟧; c. imperat., ⟦1 Corinthians 3:21|I Co 3:21⟧ ⟦1 Corinthians 4:5|4:5⟧, ⟦Philippians 2:12|Phl 2:12⟧ ⟦1 Thessalonians 4:18|I Th 4:18⟧, ⟦1 Peter 4:19|I Pe 4:19⟧, al

⟪1.⟫ assistance, help (Thuc., Plat., al.).
⟪2.⟫ profit, advantage, benefit (Hdt., Plat., al.): ⟦Romans 3:1|Ro 3:1⟧, ⟦Jude 1:16|Ju 16⟧.†

(< ὄφελος), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨יָעַל⁩ hi. ;] to help, benefit, do good, profit: absol., ⟦Romans 2:25|Ro 2:25⟧; οὐδέν (do no good; v. Field, Notes, 21), ⟦Matthew 27:24|Mt 27:24⟧, ⟦John 6:63|Jo 6:63⟧ ⟦John 12:19|12:19⟧; c. acc pers., ⟦Hebrews 4:2|He 4:2⟧; c. dupl. acc, ⟦Mark 8:36|Mk 8:36⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 14:6|I Co 14:6⟧, ⟦Galatians 5:2|Ga 5:2⟧; pass., ⟦Hebrews 13:9|He 13:9⟧; c. acc, ⟦Matthew 15:5|Mt 15:5⟧ ⟦Matthew 16:26|16:26⟧, ⟦Mark 5:26|Mk 5:26⟧ ⟦Mark 7:11|7:11⟧, ⟦Luke 9:25|Lk 9:25⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 13:3|I Co 13:3⟧.†
